name: My Life in Another World Full of Horny Monster Girls
source:
The current project is a visual novel about a 30-year-old virgin who finds himself in another world. The new world lives by different rules, and one of the main changes is that it is now the animal girl's heat season.

I want to reveal this world from the other side. What it would be like to be a man in this world. Reverse rape, harassment and of course loneliness of girls in this world. You could build romantic relationship or hanging out with new friends and have sex with different girls.

[Edited from [url=https://animegirl-azumi.itch.io/another-horny-life]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作讲的是一个30岁的处男来到异世界的故事。这个世界有一套不同的规则，眼下最要紧的区别之一，就是这里的兽耳女孩正处在发情期。

我想从另一面来写这个世界：作为男人，生活在这里会是什么体验？他会遭遇来自女性的强暴与骚扰，也会看见这里的女孩们有多寂寞。你可以认真经营一段恋情，也可以和新朋友四处闲逛，和不同的女孩发生关系。

〔编译自[url=https://animegirl-azumi.itch.io/another-horny-life]itch.io[/url]〕
